title: fix(plugin-sharing)!: an unproven owner anchor on a federated object narrows the read and bulk-write scopes, never leaves them unscoped
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiCYUqfgybT1XmDEJf4JRV5j)_
Fixes #27425
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 外部（federated）对象上，`owner_id` 只有在 `fields` 声明、或 `external.columnMap` 把某个远端列映射到 `owner_id` 时，才算"有所有者列"。否则（平台注入的锚点）读过滤在 `org` 以下的读深度不再返回 `null`（不加过滤），而是 deny-all（只保留待审批记录那条按 id 的分支）；批量写过滤同样收紧。fail-closed：证明不了就收窄，绝不放宽。
- **为什么改：** 以前只看 `fields` 声明，没声明就当"没有所有者列"、读不加范围；但 driver 仍可能返回 `owner_id`，于是 `private` 对象对成员不设防。
- **可见变化（BREAKING，patch）：** 这类 `private` 外部对象上，成员读不到行；成员 PATCH 由 403 变为 404（编辑前的读同样被收窄）。`public_read` 仍是 403。`org` 深度、Modify All、系统调用、本地对象、声明了 `owner_id` 的外部对象都不变。示例里的两个外部对象是 `public_read_write`，不受影响。
- **先看：** `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts`（`buildReadFilter` / `buildWriteFilter` 的 phantom 分支挪到 `org` 判定之后并改为收窄）、`federated-phantom-anchors.ts`（`mapsRemoteColumnOntoOwner`）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing exec vitest run src/federated-phantom-owner-scoping.test.ts src/external-owner-anchor-sql-read.test.ts`，预期 55 个用例全过。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

Record sharing decides whether a federated object's `owner_id` is a real column by provenance (`hasPhantomOwnerAnchor`). That test read `fields` only, and a `true` answer made `buildReadFilter` / `buildWriteFilter` return `null` (#7858: "ownership contributes nothing"). A driver can still serve `owner_id` without the schema declaring it, so the unscoped read handed a `private` object's rows to members.

- **Provenance.** The owner column is proven when `fields` declares `owner_id` (unchanged) or an `external.columnMap` entry maps a remote column onto `owner_id` (new: `mapsRemoteColumnOntoOwner`). The built-in SQL drivers apply the map and serve the column; a driver that does not apply it serves no `owner_id`, so the owner predicate admits no row there (plugin drivers are floored by the engine since #27403). The map counting as declared keeps the wording of #27422's warning true ("serves the check on a built-in SQL driver").
- **Read filter.** On an unproven anchor, below `org` read depth: no owner predicate and no share rows (a grant on such an object is already refused as inert by `inertGrantReason`); the pending-approval arm stays (an id list the approvals service vouches for). The answer is `{ id: { $in: approvalIds } }` or `{ id: '__deny_all__' }`. `org` still returns `null` (it never reads the owner column). The principal-less case now reaches the existing deny-all.
- **Bulk write filter.** The same narrowing (`{ id: '__deny_all__' }` below `org`). It returned `null` before, wider than `checkEdit` / `checkDelete`, which refuse every row of such an object. This is the declared deviation from the card's read-only task list.
- **Unit scope (`owning_business_unit_id`).** Checked: no read or write gate composes a predicate over it. `unit` / `unit_and_below` resolve to an `owner_id $in` set through the hierarchy resolver, so they take the same narrowing (pinned at every non-`org` depth).

Follow-on wording, each a sentence this fix makes false (surface amendments 1 and 2 on the card): the `security-external-owner-unmapped` message names `404` on `private` and keeps `403` elsewhere; its `os explain` text says reads are refused; the virtual-objects callout says `404`; the external-datasources guide says what `private` needs after its first example.

## Tests

- `federated-phantom-owner-scoping.test.ts`: the #7858 `null` pins flip to deny-all at every non-`org` depth (read and bulk write), `org` stays `null`, principal-less deny-all, an external principal on a `public_read` phantom object closed, the approval arm kept. New rows-level block over the sharing double: a plugin driver returning undeclared `owner_id` reads no row; `columnMap` onto `owner_id` reads own-only; a driver that does not apply the map reads no row; declared reads own-only.
- New `external-owner-anchor-sql-read.test.ts`: real `ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3) + the sharing middleware over a remote owner column. Served but neither declared nor mapped: no row; `columnMap` onto `owner_id`: own-only; declared: own-only. A premise case shows the driver serves `owner_id` on all three.
- `plugin-driver-external-object.spike.test.ts` (e3): 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, no `driver.update`, and the scoped pre-image read carries the deny sentinel.
- `validate-external-owner-sharing.test.ts`: one case pinning the refusal wording per model.
- Ablation: with `sharing-service.ts` at `origin/main` and the tests at head, 12 pins go red (every new read/write deny-all pin, both rows-level undeclared cases, the SQL undeclared case); restored, green.

## Verification

Local, at head. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test`: 58 files / 1290 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 177 files / 7590 passed. `@objectstack/plugin-security`: 236 files / 5111 passed. Runtime spike + federated boot binding: 16 passed. REST external tests: 15 passed. `typecheck` (tsc + `check:test-typecheck`) clean for plugin-sharing, lint and runtime. Derived gates: see the os-dev report on the card.
